strings.zh: 从这边走{NEWLINE}自行车道的话,{CLEAR}是一段艰苦的上坡路哦。{CLEAR}这下有你好受的了~{SCROLL}不过喜欢自行车的话,{NEWLINE}唉嘿呀,唉嘿呀的{CLEAR}蹬一回也不错呢。
strings.en: Taking Cycling Road from this end means{NEWLINE}a tough uphill climb. You’re in for a{CLEAR}rough ride~{SCROLL}But if you love bikes, huffing and{NEWLINE}puffing up it once isn’t so bad either.
strings.notes: US 0359/0 | RV014: omission: restored 这下有你好受的了 and the heave-ho pedalling

strings.zh: 嘿！那个谁！{SCROLL}自行车道可是自行车的{CLEAR}专用道路。{SCROLL}非要走的话,{NEWLINE}骑自行车来吧~！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hey, you!{SCROLL}Cycling Road is for cyclists only.{NEWLINE}You have to be on a Bicycle if you want{CLEAR}to proceed!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你就是药店婆婆派来送药的小伙子吧？{NEWLINE}我是狩猎场的园长巴奥巴,{CLEAR}把药给我就好。
strings.en: You must be the young man the old lady{NEWLINE}from the herbal shop sent with the{CLEAR}medicine? I’m Baoba, the Safari Zone{CLEAR}Warden. Just hand it to me.
strings.notes: #2 (young man) / #3 (young lady): male/female player variants. Ends the Secret Potion delivery from 0348/0349.

strings.zh: 你就是药店婆婆派来送药的小姑娘吧？{NEWLINE}我是狩猎场的园长巴奥巴,{CLEAR}把药给我就好。
strings.en: You must be the young lady the old lady{NEWLINE}from the herbal shop sent with the{CLEAR}medicine? I’m Baoba, the Safari Zone{CLEAR}Warden. Just hand it to me.

strings.zh: 谢谢你来送药,{NEWLINE}哈克龙现在病情严重,{CLEAR}我必须赶紧回去了。
strings.en: Thank you for bringing the medicine.{NEWLINE}Dragonair is in bad shape. I have to{CLEAR}hurry back.
